    from waldur_api_client.client import AuthenticatedClient
from waldur_api_client.models.post_award_status_enum import PostAwardStatusEnum # (1)
from waldur_api_client.models.proposal_o_enum import ProposalOEnum # (2)
from waldur_api_client.models.proposal_run_phase_enum import ProposalRunPhaseEnum # (3)
from waldur_api_client.models.proposal_run_state_enum import ProposalRunStateEnum # (4)
from waldur_api_client.models.proposal_states import ProposalStates # (5)
from waldur_api_client.models.responsible_role_enum import ResponsibleRoleEnum # (6)
from waldur_api_client.api.proposal_proposals import proposal_proposals_list # (7)

client = AuthenticatedClient(
    base_url="https://api.example.com", token="YOUR_API_TOKEN"
)
response = proposal_proposals_list.sync(client=client)

for item in response:
    print(item)

    import { proposalProposalsList } from 'waldur-js-client';

try {
  const response = await proposalProposalsList({
  auth: "Token YOUR_API_TOKEN"
});
  console.log('Success:', response);
} catch (error) {
  console.error('Error:', error);
}
    Name Type Description
    as_role string Only proposals the current user holds this role on


    Enum: call_manager, offering_manager, reviewer, panel_member, panel_chair, applicant, proposal_role
    call_uuid string (uuid)
    changes_requested boolean Only proposals waiting on changes asked of their applicant
    created_by_uuid string (uuid)
    final_report_overdue boolean Only proposals whose final report is past its due date
    involved boolean Only proposals the current user takes part in, leaving out those read only through staff or support access
    my_proposals boolean
    name string
    o array Ordering
    organization_uuid string (uuid)
    page integer A page number within the paginated result set.
    page_size integer Number of results to return per page.
    panel_uuid string (uuid) Panel UUID
    post_award_status array Where an accepted proposal's extension or final report stands
    round string (uuid)
    round_uuid string (uuid)
    run_phase string Only proposals with a run of this phase


    Enum: closing, extension
    run_state string Only proposals with a run in this state


    Enum: open, approved, rejected, withdrawn, expired
    slug string Slug
    state array
    workflow_step array Multiple values may be separated by commas.

    200 -

    The response body is an array of objects, where each object has the following structure:

    Field Type Description
    uuid string (uuid)
    url string (uri)
    slug string
    name string
    description string
    project_name string
    project_summary string
    supporting_documentation array of objects
    supporting_documentation.uuid string (uuid)
    supporting_documentation.file string (uri) Upload supporting documentation in PDF format.
    supporting_documentation.file_name string
    supporting_documentation.file_size integer
    supporting_documentation.created string (date-time)
    state any
    approved_by string (uri)
    created_by string (uri)
    created_by_name string

    submitted_at string (date-time) When the proposal left draft. Null for proposals submitted before this field existed: their submission was never recorded and the only proxy, the first workflow step instance, was backfilled by migration for the oldest of them — so it is left empty rather than filled with a date that reads as fact.
    compliance_status any
    can_submit any
    awaiting_manual_advance boolean
    decision_held boolean
    open_change_requests array of objects The changes asked of the applicant and not yet submitted, earliest first: several steps of a stage may each ask at once. Each says what to change and which parts it unlocks meanwhile; the applicant may edit every part any of them unlocks, and submits them all at once. For the applicant team and those overseeing the call; empty otherwise.
    open_change_requests.uuid string (uuid)
    open_change_requests.created string (date-time)
    open_change_requests.step_uuid string (uuid) UUID of the workflow step instance the changes were asked at.
    open_change_requests.step_key string
    open_change_requests.step_name string
    open_change_requests.contribution_uuid string (uuid)
    open_change_requests.message string What is to change, for the applicant, or for the contributor of a reopened contribution.
    open_change_requests.unlocked_parts array of strings The parts the applicant may edit while the request is open: field:, documents, resources, team, compliance.
    open_change_requests.due_at string (date-time) When the changes are due. Past it, the request lapses and the step returns to its actor.
    open_change_requests.is_open boolean
    open_change_requests.closed_at string (date-time)
    open_change_requests.resolution any How the request was closed; empty while it is open.
    open_change_requests.requested_by_name string Who asked; not told to the applicant team, as the step's actor may be one of its evaluators.
    reads_own_offerings_only boolean Whether the caller reads the proposal only as the provider of some of the offerings it requests: its requested resources, award, assessments and extensions then show only their own offerings' part.
    offering_team_providers array of objects The providers whose offering requested by the proposal the caller holds a role on -- its managers, or someone its part of a step can be handed to: each opens the proposal as that offering's team. Empty for everyone else.
    offering_team_providers.uuid string (uuid)
    offering_team_providers.name string
    workflow_step string Key of the call step the proposal stands in.
    status_labels array of objects What the call configured the caller's dashboard to call the proposal's current stage: one label per step of the stage that has one for the caller (several when the stage runs steps side by side). Empty when nothing is configured, so the state stands.
    status_labels.step string Key of the step the label is for.
    status_labels.label string
    requested_duration_months integer The project length the applicant chose from the call's allowed_duration_months. Written through update_project_details.
    awarded_duration_months integer The project length the award grants, in months. Null for whoever may not read the award yet, as the awarded resources.
    completed_at string (date-time) When the project was completed: its final report accepted.
    post_award_status any Where an accepted proposal's extension request or final report stands. Null before acceptance, without post-award work, and for whoever may not read the award.
    open_run_uuid string (uuid) The open extension request or final report, if any.
    open_run_phase any
    extension_requestable_until string (date) The last day an extension can be requested; null when the call takes no extension requests or the project has no end date.
    final_report_openable boolean Whether the final report can be opened now: the proposal is accepted with a project, not completed, has no open extension request or final report, and its call has final report steps. Who may open it is decided by the action itself.

    Any signed-in user.

    Users with the staff or support flag, or a site-wide LIST_PROPOSALS grant, see every proposal. Others see the proposals of calls whose organisation's customer they hold LIST_PROPOSALS on, their applicant team's, those they hold a role on, those of calls they manage or organise, a panel member's submitted ones without a blocking conflict of interest, those they review, are assigned, contribute to or hold an evaluator role on, a results reader's once the round is published, and an offering manager's or slot delegate's for their offering's part.

    200 -

    The response body is an array of objects, where each object has the following structure:

    Field Type Description
    uuid string (uuid)
    created string (date-time)
    step_uuid string (uuid) UUID of the workflow step instance the changes were asked at.
    step_key string
    step_name string
    contribution_uuid string (uuid)
    message string What is to change, for the applicant, or for the contributor of a reopened contribution.
    unlocked_parts array of strings The parts the applicant may edit while the request is open: field:, documents, resources, team, compliance.
    due_at string (date-time) When the changes are due. Past it, the request lapses and the step returns to its actor.
    is_open boolean
    closed_at string (date-time)
    resolution any How the request was closed; empty while it is open.
    requested_by_name string Who asked; not told to the applicant team, as the step's actor may be one of its evaluators.

    Whoever sees the proposal; it lists only the requests they read (user_reads_change_request): every one for users with the staff or support flag and the call's workflow managers, a request to the applicant for the applicant team and the step's completers, a reopened contribution for its holders and the person it is handed to.

    Users with the staff or support flag, or a site-wide LIST_PROPOSALS grant, see every proposal. Others see the proposals of calls whose organisation's customer they hold LIST_PROPOSALS on, their applicant team's, those they hold a role on, those of calls they manage or organise, a panel member's submitted ones without a blocking conflict of interest, those they review, are assigned, contribute to or hold an evaluator role on, a results reader's once the round is published, and an offering manager's or slot delegate's for their offering's part.

    Users with the staff or support flag, or a site-wide LIST_PROPOSALS grant, see every proposal. Others see the proposals of calls whose organisation's customer they hold LIST_PROPOSALS on, their applicant team's, those they hold a role on, those of calls they manage or organise, a panel member's submitted ones without a blocking conflict of interest, those they review, are assigned, contribute to or hold an evaluator role on, a results reader's once the round is published, and an offering manager's or slot delegate's for their offering's part.

    Download the proposal as PDF

Each section holds exactly what the endpoint serving it returns to the caller, and is left out where that endpoint refuses them, so the applicant team, the call team and an evaluator each get their own view of the proposal.

A review created by accepting an assignment is also due no earlier than its assignment batch's deadline, so extending the batch deadline moves the deadline of the reviews accepted from it.

For the call's managers and the completer of a step collecting suggestions; never the applicant team.     200 -

    The response body is an array of objects, where each object has the following structure:

    Field Type Description
    uuid string (uuid)
    step string Key of the call step, copied from it.
    call_step_uuid string (uuid)
    kind any
    order integer Position of the step in this proposal's path.
    stage integer The stage the step runs in on this proposal: steps of one stage run at the same time, and the next stage starts once all of them have ended.
    run_uuid string (uuid) The extension request or final report the step belongs to; null for a step of the evaluation.
    phase any
    is_overdue boolean A final report past its due date, still to be submitted. Other steps lapse at their deadline instead.
    run_condition any When the step runs on this proposal, fixed when it was submitted; empty when it runs on every proposal.
    skipped_reason any Why a skipped step did not run: 'condition_not_met' when its run condition did not hold. Null otherwise.
    status_label string What the call configured the caller's dashboard to call the step in its state: the applicant team's labels on a step visible to them and on the allocation decision, else the evaluators'. Null to fall back to the computed label.
    outcome_set any Outcomes the step can be completed with.
    allowed_outcomes array of strings
    contributor_source string
    contributor_proposal_role_uuid string (uuid) The evaluator role whose holders contribute to the step, when its contributors hold one.
    per_requested_offering boolean
    round_scoped boolean Whether the step runs once per round: it is completed for the round, never on the proposal alone.
    contributors_lead_only boolean Whether only the lead of the evaluator role contributes.
    delegable_to string Who a contribution slot of the step can be handed to.
    awaiting_lead string Why the active step waits for the lead of its evaluator role, when only the lead contributes and none can; null otherwise, and for readers outside the call team.
    waiting_for string Why the active step cannot move on without someone being added or a call manager acting in another's place, with the way forward; null when its own people can move it, and for readers outside the call team.
    completion_warning string What completing the active step now leaves short, for the completer to confirm: a later review step needing more reviews than reviewers are assigned. Null otherwise, and for readers outside the call team.
    on_negative any
    contribution_outcomes array of strings Outcomes a contribution to the step may conclude with; empty when contributions carry no outcome of their own.
    is_allocation_decision boolean Whether this step settles the proposal's award.
    step_name string
    step_description string
    completer string
    responsible_role string
    completer_proposal_role_uuid string (uuid) The evaluator role whose holders complete the step, if any.
    completer_proposal_role_name string
    status any
    outcome string Step-specific outcome (e.g., eligible, feasible, approved).
    outcome_reason string Explanation for the outcome (e.g., rejection reason).
    rejection_reason string
    internal_notes string
    started_at string (date-time) When this step became active.
    completed_at string (date-time)
    completed_by string (uuid)
    deadline string (date-time) Computed from started_at + step duration_in_days.
    applicant_visible boolean
    duration_in_days integer
    is_required boolean
    checklist_status any
    input_step_uuids array of string (uuid)s
    release_to_applicant boolean Whether the step's report is released to the applicant.
    released_at string (date-time) When the step's report was released to the applicant.
    can_release boolean Whether the caller may release the step's report to the applicant now: its completer or those overseeing the call, once the step is completed and not yet released.
    collects_reviewer_suggestions boolean Whether the step's contributors suggest reviewers for the proposal.
    allows_change_requests boolean Whether whoever acts on the step may send the proposal back to its applicant for changes.
    can_suggest_reviewers boolean Whether the caller may suggest a reviewer through the step now: it is the active step collecting suggestions and the caller's own contribution to it is still open.
    ready_to_complete boolean For whoever may complete the active step: every contribution is in and its completion gates are met, so it waits only for them. False for everyone else.
    score_gate any The active step's score against its minimum score threshold, before anyone decides: below it, only declining is possible. Null without a threshold, once the step is no longer active, and for readers outside the call team.
    decided_automatically boolean Whether the system took this allocation decision itself, on a call whose decision decides automatically.

    Whoever sees the proposal; the steps of its post-award runs only for those who read its runs (user_can_view_runs).

    Users with the staff or support flag, or a site-wide LIST_PROPOSALS grant, see every proposal.     Field Type Description

    conflicts.status string
    conflicts.coi_type string
    conflicts.severity string

    holds_evaluator_role boolean
    is_on_applicant_team boolean
    already_in_pool boolean

    Role assignments

    Assign an evaluator role on the proposal. Call managers at any time, the completer of an assignment step for the role while it runs -- who may make someone the lead only while the role has none, or when they are its lead handing it over. Refused for an ineligible user, a recorded conflict of interest, a member of the applicant team, or one holder too many.

    Set panel

    Move the proposal to another panel of its call, or off any panel. For those who manage the call and the completer of the proposal's running assignment step that assigns a role held through its panel. The chair the workflow assigned from the old panel, who has done nothing on the proposal yet, is revoked with the move; any other holder of a role held through the panel refuses it: revoke them first. When the proposal's assignment step is running, the new panel's chair takes the roles held by the panel's chair. Logged on the proposal's event feed, which the applicant team does not read.

    200 -

    Field Type Description
    uuid string (uuid)
    phase any The post-award phase the run walks: extension or closing.
    state any
    opened_at string (date-time)
    opened_by_name string
    closed_at string (date-time)
    requested_end_date string (date) Extension: the end date the applicant asks for.
    requested_limits object (free-form) Extension: the limits the applicant asks for, per resource.
    granted_end_date string (date) Extension: the end date the decision grants.
    granted_limits object (free-form) Extension: the limits the decision grants, per resource.
    granted_by_name string Extension: who set what the decision grants.
    applied_changes object (free-form) Extension: what the approval changed -- the end date requests recorded and the orders created -- and what it left alone, and why.
    active_step_uuid string (uuid) The run's step that is running now, if any.
    active_step_kind string

    An accepted proposal's extension requests and final report are read by whoever reads its award (user_can_view_runs): users with the staff or support flag, the call's managers, the managers of the offerings involved, and the applicant team once the award is released.
